en: What are they going on about?

Rincho is what they call a donation.
One is equivalent to... 100,000 yen.

You mean... Mie-san is going to
give this crazy cult 10 million yen?
There's no way she has that kind of money.

She must have borrowed it from her family.
We can't let her go through with this!

Now then, my disciples.
You may return to the splendor of your shooreh pippi.

What now, old man? Do you think we'd find
Mie-san if we followed their guru?
Well then, let's do it.
Where are you going, Brothers?

Oh, um... We only just joined the order today.
We wanted to introduce ourselves to the guru.
Hm... Do you have the rincho necessary to do so?
Well, that's actually what I wanted to ask him about.
How do you mean?

I'm but a poor, frail old man. As such, I was planning
on finding a moneylender for my titherance.
But is a rincho of borrowed money truly acceptable?

Would the divine savior Munan Chohept Onast
still welcome such a feeble attempt at devotion?
Of course he would.

Your devout nature is deeply moving, Brother.
You have no need to doubt yourself.
Ah, I'm so glad to hear that!

But honestly, I'm still afraid to go to a moneylender.
Some direct encouragement from the guru could help.

(The old man lies through his
teeth like it's nothing...)

Very well, I will show you to him.
You have adequately proven your devotion. However...

Are you a sincere follower of Munan Chohept Onast?
Mind if I ask you a few questions to confirm?
A test?

I must be sure you will not embarrass
yourself in front of the guru.

Worry not. If you have listened attentively,
it should be a simple task for you.
Fine. I'll ace this, no problem.

Very well.
Question one will test your basic understanding.

In the Order of Munan Chohept Onast,
how does one express gratitude?
Dolche uho.

Did you say dolche uho...?
How dare you utter those words!
That phrase is reserved only for our guru!

Hey, Kiryu-san! You can't say that!
Dolche uho means, um...
It means "drink my breast milk"!
...Why would the guru ever say that?

The correct answer is hept-onast.
Please remember that going forward.
Hept-onast for telling me, Brother.
Incorrect. That is our greeting, remember?

Glory be! That's correct!
It seems you were paying close attention.

That one was easy.
I could pass this test in my sleep.
Now then, on to question two.

Through shooreh pippi, you accumulate a particular
unit of virtue. What does our order call that unit?

Almost! The correct answer is kulipaas.
Most new disciples struggle with that question.
Damn, I should be better than that.

Correct! Glory be, it seems you have studied well.
You are quite a promising disciple.
Yes. It's all thanks to my devoted shooreh pippi.
Moving right along. Question three.

Please tell me the full name of the guru
of the Order of Munan Chohept Onast.
Munan Suzuki.
Ah, so very close.

Munan Suzuki is actually our order's founder.
I'm surprised you've heard about him.
Wait, really? I was just guessing...

Years ago, Munan Suzuki was arrested due to
the government's irrational fear of Munan Chohept Onast.

They falsely accused our order
of being a scam, and our guru a fraud.

However, under Munan Akamatsu's holy guidance,
our order will endure eternally. Glory be.
Munan Akamatsu.

Wonderfully done.
That may have been a bit too simple, though.
I'd never mistake the name of our holy guru.

Munan Akamatsu inherited his power
from our order's founder, Munan Suzuki.
Munan Suzuki...?

Unfortunately, Munan Suzuki was arrested due to
the government's irrational fear of Munan Chohept Onast.
Munan Sato.

What? How have you mistaken the name of our guru!?
The correct answer is Munan Akamatsu. Such impiety.
Oh, I remember now.

Please commit this to memory. Munan Akamatsu inherited
his power from our order's founder, Munan Suzuki.
At last, the final question is upon us.

Please describe the true meaning of chomo gomes.
Do you know the answer?
It's brainwashing, isn't it?
Excuse me? Brainwashing?

There is no such word within our holy order.
Who told you such blasphemy?

It seems I cannot allow you to meet the guru. Your test
has concluded. Please return to your shooreh pippi.
Sorry, but I really need to see him.

You must earn an audience with our guru, Brother.
Your understanding is greatly appreciated.
If you still insist...

What'll happen?
Are you going to chomo gomes me?
Precisely. It is the only course of action available.
Try me. I'm not afraid of this chomo gomes crap.
Guards!

Now, show this impudent disciple what
happens when you defy Munan Chohept Onast!
Precisely. I am afraid that was too easy for you.
Sex education.

You mean re-education!
That's an odd mistake to make... Was that intentional?
That concludes our test.
I must say, incredible job.

This is but your first day in our order, but you clearly
hold Munan Chohept Onast dear to your heart.
That was amazing, Kiryu-san.

I hope our other new Friends will follow in
your footsteps. You have passed the test.
Oh, it was nothing.

As the two of you requested, I will introduce
you to our holy guru. Please follow me.

(Mie-san should be in the back with the guru.
I hope she hasn't given her titherance yet...)

It seems you have solid fundamentals.
Continue the hard work to reach salvation, Brother.

I will. Before that though,
will you let us meet with the guru?

Yes. As requested, I will introduce him to you.
Please follow me, Brothers.

Hm... It appears you have yet to imbue
the values of shooreh pippi into your being.

This is but your first day, but you don't seem particularly
invested in our order. You cannot meet the guru.

I'd appreciate it if you made an exception,
just for a few minutes. Please let me see him.
I cannot.

Please, we'll make it quick!
I'll give a rincho for my friend as well!
No means no.
But...!
Please, return to your shooreh pippi.

Your eyes betray your true nature, Brother.
You are but a demon who lacks the fear of faith...
Just take me to your damn guru.

Hey, are these guys really done already?
I don't think your chomo gomes worked very well.
Y-You're incredible, Kiryu-san.
Why don't you take us to the founder now?

V-Very well, then.
Please come with me, you two.
Excuse me, Your Holiness.

Our new Friends here have requested
an audience with you. They only just joined today.

Both of them are immensely devoted.
Please offer them your blessing.

Their faith is promising, though not fully developed yet.
Please offer them your blessing.

They're, well... They have a few issues. They are quite
passionate though, so please offer them your blessing.

Very well, then. It fills my heart with joy to
see you here, Friends. Please accept this.
Some blessing this is...
Did you say something?

Your Holiness, Mie-san's purification is complete.
She is ready for the 100 rincho titherance.

Very well. This is a crucial ceremony, my new Friends.
Return to your shooreh pippi at once.
Mie-san!

Huh? Suzuki-san?
What're ya doing here?
Please, head back to the other room.

Mie-san, you can't go through with this!
This order is nothing but a scam!
Don't give them a single yen!
Silence!

Suzuki-san! That's enough o' yer blasphemy!
Apologize to the guru, now!
I won't!

It appears you misunderstand our order's intentions.
I am aware that many perceive us as a simple scam.

However, our faith burns bright
through the darkness of their slander.

Our love for Munan Chohept Onast
will carry us across the ocean of lies around us.

You are free to doubt our order, but you will face divine
punishment if you disrupt the faith of an innocent Friend.
Huh. You've really grown into an expert con artist.
Old man?
You used to be Munan Chohept Onast's treasurer, yes?

After the arrest of the founder Munan Suzuki,
you took over the order with money you had stashed away.

I know I've aged,
but you should still recognize me.
I used to be known as Munan Suzuki.

You're Munan Suzuki?
No way...!
What are you doing here!?

Kiryu-san, Mie-san. I'm sorry for hiding this from you.
However, this is my true identity.

The divine savior Munan Chohept Onast doesn't exist.
I dreamed him up years ago.
All of your prayers have fallen on deaf ears.
Listen to me, Mie-san.

Your late husband would be turning in his grave
if he saw you now. You know that, right?

Are you sure you want to go through
with this 100 rincho titherance?

How ridiculous.
You've become quite the joke, Munan Suzuki.

And you used to be the gold standard of frauds.
Did your time in prison soften you up?

That's not it. I just can't stand
to see my crimes carried on anymore.
You traitor.

Lock the doors!
Don't let anyone else in!
What are you going to do, Your Holiness?

Suzuki-san, Mie-san. Stand back.
This might get a little ugly.

How dare you slander Munan Chohept Onast!
The only way forward for you is... chomo gomes!
It hurts... It hurts so much...
What's wrong, Your Holiness?

Ah, Friends!
Hurry, you must call me an ambulance!

Our guru is gravely injured!
We must perform the Ritual of Healing, everyone!

Y-You dipshits!
That's not gonna fix a damn thing!

You know, I'm getting the craziest deja vu...
I feel like I was in this exact situation before.

Stop waving your hands around
and call me an ambulance!
Mie-san should be okay now.

The other disciples heard what happened.
They've been leaving the cult in droves.

This is all because of you, Kiryu-san.
I can't thank you enough.
Here. This is a token of my appreciation.

You ended up demolishing this order's resurgence,
but is that the real reason you came to this town?
To be honest... no.

I was actually thinking I would reclaim
my position as Munan Chohept Onast's guru.
After I got out of jail, I had nowhere to go.

But if I returned to be the guru,
I knew I could belong somewhere again.

I didn't plan on meeting someone as wonderful
as Mie-san before I got back to the order, though.

And well, I didn't expect
I'd fall in love with her, either.

What about Mie-san?
Has she said anything to you?
Not a word.

I'm not surprised. I spent a long time deceiving
people just like her. I destroyed countless lives, Kiryu-san.
It's only right that I pay the price for that now.
I guess the sins you commit never really fade away...

Even so, I feel like what we did today was
the first step toward atoning for my past.

I wouldn't have been able to do it
without you and Mie-san.
If there really is a divine being out there...

...I'm sure he'd be lenient on a guy
who faces his sins head on like that.
Fine tofu for sale!

Hey, you there!
How about some tofu?
Hm? No thanks, I'm good.

You just don't know how tasty it is!
Please! Won't you give it a shot?
I told you I don't want any.

You'd only have to buy one!
If you don't, I won't...
You're annoying me now.
Hm...? Wait...
No way... Pocket Circuit Fighter?

Huh? Wait...
Aren't you... Kazuma-kun!?

It's been too long...
We met way back in the bubble, so...
I guess it's been about 30 years.
Has it been that long?

It feels like only yesterday that we were
racing Pocket Circuit cars in Kamurocho.

Yeah. It's weird, but I feel the same way.
Those were the days...

But man, you've really aged.
I didn't even recognize you.

Heh, likewise. You don't yell with
quite the same gusto you had then.

Hmm, really?
Well, people change.

Never figured I'd run into you in Onomichi...
You're running a tofu shop?

Yeah. Not long after I retired,
I came back to Hiroshima, my hometown.

What about you?
Here to see the sights?

Nah, I'm here on business,
so I'll be around for a while.

I see. Then, if our schedules line up,
we should catch up over some<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>
[Hey! Daddy!]
Hm? "Daddy"?

Let me introduce you.
This is Sakito, my son!
Pocket Circuit Fighter has a son!?
Heh... So you finally became a man.
Let's not dwell on that, maybe...

[Daddy!] Who is this guy?
[Who is this dandy man?]

This guy was one of my racing buddies.
His name's Kazuma-kun.

Kazuma-san? How do you do?
[Nice to meet you!]

[N-Nice to...]
Some kid you've got there.

Surprised? We decided he should
have daily English lessons.
English lessons...?

Hm? Wait, Sakito.
Don't you have English class today?
Um, well...
There you are!
[M-Mommy...]

You better hurry, or you'll be late for
English class! Don't make this hard for Mommy!
[But...] But...

Don't talk back! Listen, Sakito.
Society is only going to go more global!

If you can't speak English, you'll end up
running a tacky tofu shop like your daddy!
